root_cause.text: The ovpn_tcp_socket_detach() function dereferences sk->sk_socket without holding sk->sk_callback_lock, allowing a concurrent tcp_close() to set sk->sk_socket to NULL via sock_orphan(), leading to a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explains that tcp_close() sets sk->sk_socket to NULL while the peer is in the release list, and ovpn_tcp_socket_detach() subsequently crashes when accessing sk->sk_socket. The patch adds write_lock_bh(&sk->sk_callback_lock) and a NULL check before accessing sk->sk_socket->ops, preventing the race.
